h1.en: The Diesel 120 Concrete Pump inquiry starts from the printed page
h1.zh: 柴油120型混凝土泵的询盘从已印页面开始

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump at /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump. Copy only the printed cells: Model Diesel 120; Engine Power (Diesel) 290 kW (two units 145 kW); Theoretical Output 100 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 40 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³; Conveying Distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112 (two units); Max. Aggregate Size 6 cm and below; Dimensions (L×W×H) 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm; Main Unit Weight 8000 kg. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm and Main Unit Weight is 8000 kg. The printed output cell is 100 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Conveying Distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. The printed power cell is 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. The printed aggregate or particle cell is 6 cm and below. Send the maximum stone or particle size in the mix. If the mix is coarser, this row is the wrong page. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai. The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Formwork. It shows: The concrete structure of the Royal National Theatre carries the impression of the timber shuttering. It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油120型混凝土泵列在 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump。只抄已印格子：型号 Diesel 120; 柴油机功率 290 kW (two units 145 kW); 理论输送量 100 m³/h; 最大出口压力 40 MPa; 料斗容积 0.6 m³; 输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m; 液压泵 Kawasaki 112 (two units); 最大骨料粒径 6 cm and below; 外形尺寸 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm; 整机重量 8000 kg。运输请抄外形尺寸是 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm，整机重量是 8000 kg。已印输送量是 100 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。已印动力是 290 kW (two units 145 kW)。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。已印骨料或粒径是 6 cm and below。询盘写混合物里的最大石子或粒径。料更粗时，这一行就不是该打开的页面。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。这篇配图是 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Formwork 页面里的内容图片。画面主体：混凝土。它只作询盘主题的参考。它不是河北品锦机械的铭牌，不是报价单，也不是出口案例。

body.en: Put /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump in the subject. The published cells are: Model Diesel 120; Engine Power (Diesel) 290 kW (two units 145 kW); Theoretical Output 100 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 40 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³; Conveying Distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112 (two units); Max. Aggregate Size 6 cm and below; Dimensions (L×W×H) 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm; Main Unit Weight 8000 kg. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump。已公布的格子是：型号 Diesel 120; 柴油机功率 290 kW (two units 145 kW); 理论输送量 100 m³/h; 最大出口压力 40 MPa; 料斗容积 0.6 m³; 输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m; 液压泵 Kawasaki 112 (two units); 最大骨料粒径 6 cm and below; 外形尺寸 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm; 整机重量 8000 kg。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Output, distance, power and particle size
heading.zh: 输送量、距离、动力和粒径

body.en: The printed output cell is 100 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Conveying Distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. The printed power cell is 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. The printed aggregate or particle cell is 6 cm and below. Send the maximum stone or particle size in the mix. If the mix is coarser, this row is the wrong page.
body.zh: 已印输送量是 100 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。已印动力是 290 kW (two units 145 kW)。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。已印骨料或粒径是 6 cm and below。询盘写混合物里的最大石子或粒径。料更粗时，这一行就不是该打开的页面。

heading.en: What to ask Xingtai instead of guessing
heading.zh: 该问邢台，而不是自己猜

body.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. Also send country and purchase timing as facts about your order. Do not turn them into a promised lead time or an export-country list. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
body.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。同时把国家和采购时间作为订单事实发来。不要把它们写成承诺交期，也不要写成出口国名单。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

question.en: Is a price printed for the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 柴油120型混凝土泵印了价格吗？

answer.en: No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
answer.zh: 产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

question.en: Can OEM numbers be guessed from a similar machine?
question.zh: OEM 数字能按相似机器猜吗？

answer.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print.
answer.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-120-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。
